newsitem.title: CHINA: China seen Ericsson's largest Asian mart.
newsitem.headline: China seen Ericsson's largest Asian mart.

text.p: China has become the largest Asian customer of Swedish communications firm Ericsson with the fastest growth rate for sales of Ericsson products in the world, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
The company's sales of digital switching systems and mobile telephones in China account for eight percent of its total, it said.
In 1995, sales volume in China exceeded $1.0 billion, replacing Japan as Ericsson's largest Asian market, the agency said.
Ericsson has invested $500 million in China, established eight joint ventures and hired 2,500 employees, it said.
The company has provided China with public telephone switching systems of 5.8 million lines, and its mobile phones make up 60 percent of China's market, it said but gave no more details.
